title: The lights at home
description: The Meridiana flat's lamps are the LIFX bulbs at home (docs/home-lights.md). E on a lamp opens its dial: colour wheel, brightness, quick picks and power, applied as it changes; with the lights connected the bulb at home follows within milliseconds on the LAN, and a light switched at home shows in the game. The flat is lit by its lamps. This run leaves the real lights alone: it never connects them.

steps.caption: By the round table: the arc lamp is the 'Mesa' bulb at home
E opens the lamp's dial: wheel, brightness, whites and colours, power; every change goes to the bulb as it happens
← → steps through the quick picks (pink here) and ↑ ↓ sets the brightness; the room takes the colour
The flat is lit by its lamps: the bedroom's two bulbs over the bed (one light) in red, the kitchen switched off and in shadow
Menu · Luces de casa: connect the bulbs (LAN or cloud), living room or whole house, intensity, and the lead (Auto) with its test flash
